purpose: Post-hoc diagnosis only; no training, checkpoint selection, smoothing or modification of frozen evaluations.
units: metres and seconds; Y-up; original floor y=0
vae_padding: Group by exact valid length; no padding, resampling, duplicated frames or cross-clip derivatives.
fixed_skeleton: Author HumanML3D offsets from new_joint_vecs/000021.npy, used unchanged for every clip and model.
position_fixed: Preserve each RIC bone direction and root trajectory; replace bone length by the common target length using hierarchical FK. No temporal filter.
rotation_fk: Author recover_from_rot using the independent 6D rotation channels. No position IK, no smoothing or foot IK.
high_frequency: Orthonormal DCT-II; frequency k*fps/(2*T). Report RMS and energy fraction above cutoff after per-channel demeaning; retain root-relative and world results separately.
derivatives: Forward finite differences within each full valid clip; multiply by fps^order. Vector-norm RMS over valid times and joints, not coordinate RMS.
boundary_diagnostics: Also report interior jerk after removing four frames at both ends, and jerk split by finite-difference start index modulo decoder stride 4.
aggregation: First average generation repeats within clip, then clips within subject, then subjects equally; paired bootstrap over the same target subjects. HumanML references cluster original IDs with mirrored M prefix removed.
paired_errors: MPJPE and acceleration error against GT only for VAE reconstruction; generated motions are not frame-aligned GT. Position-vs-FK errors are representation discrepancies, not reconstruction accuracy.

sampling_probe.source: The six previously fixed stand/walk/slow_walk/run/squat/jump prompts, 120 frames, seeds 20261016/17/18.
sampling_probe.interpretation: Exploratory configuration sensitivity, not a new benchmark or evidence of improved semantic quality.

posture_condition_version: Existing trained legacy-reference-v1. No weights trained for posture-world-up-v2 exist.
outputs: Chinese report; PNG-only scientific images; per-clip, per-bone and per-joint metrics; server-only complete bone-length and derivative-norm time series; auditable source/cache hashes.
